
dist/LEIA-ME-games.txt
========================================
The Games
=====

Use one folder per game, with files extracted and decrypted from YOUR OWN console, using this structure:

games\<pasta of the game>\eboot.bin
games\<pasta of the game>\ sce_sys\param.json
games\<pasta of the game>\ sce_module\ (if the game has)

The games never come with the emulator and should not be shared.

dist/LEIA-ME-system.txt
========================================
Console system libraries
=================================

Put these files, already extracted and decrypted from YOUR OWN PS5, in system\modules\
(on the console, they are in /system/common/lib/):

  libSceAgc.sprx
  libScePsml.sprx      (PS5 Pro, PSSR)

Some games require these libraries; the launcher lists any that are missing.
They NEVER come with the emulator and should not be shared with others
people (copy between your own PCs can).
The folder selected in Settings takes priority. Discovered local libraries are copied to collections in system/modules/collections. New sets are added without mixing source folders or overwriting versions. Complete copies remain available without the original drive. No libraries are downloaded.

dist/LEIA-ME.txt
========================================
ZeraPS5 {VERSION} — experimental version

Experimental emulator of PlayStation 5 for Windows x86-64.
There is no guarantee of compatibility, stability or FPS.

Language: Menu Languages, or Settings > Languages. There are 15 interface options,
including Arabic, Farsi, Russian and Ukrainian. See docs/IDIOMAS.txt.

1. Extract the ZIP into a writable folder outside Program Files.
2. Read system/LEIA-ME.txt; add only modules from your own console.
3. Open ZeraPS5.exe and add your game folders in Settings.
4. Select a game and click Play. Folders and .exfat images use the existing
   support. This package does not extract games or decrypt files.

Requirements: Windows 10/11 x64, an x86-64/AVX CPU, a Vulkan 1.3 GPU and an
up-to-date driver. Python, CMake and MSYS2 are not needed to run the executables.
The driver Vulkan comes from the manufacturer of GPU, not from this ZIP.
DualSense USB and XInput use the existing support. No new controller has been
validated in this release. See docs/LIMITACOES.txt before testing games.

user/ is created on first use and stores saves, settings, caches and logs.
Do not share this entire folder. Reports are local by default; lines
containing paths, local names and common credentials are omitted. Review the ZIP and
description before sharing: the filter cannot remove every possible piece of data.

Stable Windows x64 updates are checked automatically at
https://github.com/zeraps5/ZeraPS5-Releases/releases/latest/download/latest.json
No login, token or computer identification. the query can be disabled
in Settings. Installing a new version requires confirmation.
The installation checks integrity and
preserves user/, games/ and system/. Recovery: docs/ATUALIZACOES.txt.

Source code, FFmpeg and relinking object files: sources/ and docs/RECOMPILAR.txt.
Licenses and credits: LICENSE, CREDITS.txt and licenses/.
The package contains no games, firmware, console modules or keys. Use only
copies legally dumped from your own console. ZeraPS5 is not affiliated with Sony.

dist/docs/ATUALIZACOES.txt
========================================
Updated and Recovery

Windows x86-64 is a stable channel: zeraps5/ZeraPS5-Releases on GitHub.
The development repository zeraps5/ZeraPS5 remains private.
The destination of distribution still depends on authorized creation and publication.
The launcher queries releases/latest/download/latest.json by HTTPS, without token,
computer name or installation ID. Do not use the REST API.
The latest redirect selects the stable release.
HTTP 403/429 or network failure preserve the installation, without continuous repetition.

The new version is offered for confirmation. the application awaits the launcher
Closing, not closing processes and refusing to update with this active folder.
Confers SHA-256 of the ZIP, canal/arquitetura and hash/tamanho of the internal files.
External routes, links, collisions and personal files are rejected.
user/, games/ and system/ are not replaced.

Backups and daily remains at user/updates/transaction. A failure copy restore
A break during the copy displays recovery in the
For manual recovery, close this installation and use:
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "user/updates/Recuperar-ZeraPS5.ps1" -InstallRoot "PASTA_DA_INSTALACAO" -Recover
The recovery copy is created when you start an update. see also
user/updates/result.txt. Keep transaction/backup until validate the new version.

SHA-256 verifies integrity with respect to the manifesto obtained by HTTPS;
This is not a digital signature.This candidate has no digital signature.

By default, the program checks for updates on startup. You can also use Check for updates on the main screen. Startup checks can be disabled in Settings.

dist/docs/IDIOMAS.txt
========================================
Language of the interface of ZeraPS5

Open the Language menu at the top of the launch. There is also a button
The choice is saved when confirmed and valid in the next
Opening; the menus and the main screen change immediately, without re-starting games.

15 of the options:
- Português (Brasil) — pt-BR
- Português (Portugal) — pt-PT
- Inglês — en
- Espanhol — es
- Francês — fr
- Alemão — de
- Italiano — it
- Japonês — ja
- Coreano — ko
- Chinês simplificado — zh-CN
- Chinês tradicional — zh-TW
- Árabe — ar
- Farsi (persa) — fa
- Russo — ru
- Ucraniano — uk

Arabic and farsi use reading and disposal from right to left.
The roads and upgrade address fields continue from the left to the left
The right to preserve your reading. the options show your native names
It is easy to return to the desired language.

The preference is in [interface] language of user/config/zeraps5.ini and is
independent of [general] language, which informs the console language to the game.
It does not install translations, sources or language files in the games.
The language and the languages available in each game depends on your files.

Menus, checks, warnings, errors, fields of reports and results of the report
Updates use the chosen language. Open Technical Help to read the help
See log shows the new records in the chosen language, even
If the preference changes after the execution.

Codes, file names, hardware models and games titles are given
The user's written description is not translated.
The original records continue at user/logs for diagnosis.
Previous without structured registration need to be executed again for
The structured copy is limited to 64 MiB by
The window shows up to 1 MiB of the final stage of the view.
Licenses and credits maintain their original texts and their validity.

The catalogues are at frontends/launcher/. Generators check the parameters
tools/check_localization.py verifies coverage and reproduction.
Technical translations were assisted by local software and revised in part.
They still need review by native speakers of all languages.

dist/docs/LIMITACOES.txt
========================================
Limitations of this experimental version

docs/COMPATIBILIDADE.md lists the tested sections, the hardware
and the build of each result. Reaching gameplay in one section does not prove
that the whole game works. Performance varies by game and computer.

Ratchet and Atlantis have results from the Iris Xe notebook. The nine results
on the RTX 5060 Ti were obtained on main 1c4893f, build 756.
The synthetic graphics tests for this release are run on the RTX 5060 Ti.
Astro Bot still has missing objects/characters and is not advertised as playable.
Diablo II still has no confirmed gameplay. Other titles have
graphics defects, system failures or slow performance.

Opt-in experiments retain their activation defaults. The package includes
only the program, documentation, licenses and source code. Games and console modules
must be provided by the user from their own copies.

dist/docs/RECOMPILAR.txt
========================================
Corresponding sources and religation

sources/ZeraPS5-source.zip contains real sources, tests, heads, CMake,
scripts, materials dist/ and licenses of the review indicated in the manifesto.
The automatic GitHub 'Source code' file does not replace these sources.
There is no Git administration, personal history or machine settings.

Requirements: Windows x64, MSYS2 UCRT64 GCC/binutils/make, CMake >= 3.21 and nasm
to reconstruct FFmpeg. Extract the sources ZeraPS5; put ffmpeg-7.1.2.tar.xz
at third_party/ffmpeg/ and run at MSYS2 UCRT64: sh tools/build_ffmpeg.sh
Then with UCRT64/bin on the PATH:
cmake -S . -B build/distribution -G "MinGW Makefiles" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
cmake --build build/distribution --parallel 2
ctest --test-dir build/distribution --output-on-failure

To exchange FFmpeg, altere/recompile your sources and reconstruct ZeraPS5 against
The new include/lib. ZeraPS5-relink-objects.zip also provides objects of the
The application and link.txt with the order of the libraries to religate without recalling.
Replace <Source>/<BUILD> with its maps and libav*.a with the reconstructed version;
The command is executed in the build directory. MinGW libraries come from MSYS2.

SOURCE-VERSION.txt preserves the identification without.git. equality byte byte
between different toolchains has not been certified. There are no additional restrictions
use, modification, cleaning or redistribution beyond the applicable licenses.
